active_cell.rule: subtract exactly one only at the language boundary

control.rule: subtract exactly one; do not reorder controls

equation_and_variable_blocks.matlab: block order is supplied by LinearizedProblem/model metadata
equation_and_variable_blocks.python: must preserve the same named block order
equation_and_variable_blocks.rule: never infer order from sorted dictionary keys

perforation.rule: convert cell and well maps independently; sparse matrix data are not indices

timestep.matlab: states{1} is the first completed schedule step; state0 is separate
timestep.python: states[0] is the first completed schedule step; state0 is separate
timestep.rule: do not prepend state0 to the adjoint states list

well.matlab: schedule.control(...).W order is authoritative and 1-based when used as an index
well.python: preserve W order and use 0-based indices
well.rule: name matching may build a permutation but may not sort wells

jacobian_order.sparse_contract: shape, row, column, data, duplicate accumulation and transpose must match
jacobian_order.state_variable_order: model primaryVariables followed by facility/well variables exactly as returned by MRST
jacobian_order.status: frozen as a contract; numeric Jacobian arrays are a Stage 12 Gate

objective_and_gradient_sign.evaluateMatchFromEclipseRun: returns -sum(matchObservedOWGProfile) and the negative scaled gradient
objective_and_gradient_sign.matchObservedOWGProfile: returns one non-negative mismatch contribution per timestep
objective_and_gradient_sign.optimizer: optimizeBoundConstrainedForFAHM defaults maximize=true and internally minimizes the negated callback
objective_and_gradient_sign.rule: value and gradient signs are migrated as one indivisible contract

parameterization.concatenation: getScaledParameterVector vertically concatenates each ModelParameter vector in config order
parameterization.dimension: one value per selected active cell/endpoint entry; never one scalar multiplier per field

reshape_and_storage.rule: numpy default C-order is forbidden for MATLAB-derived flattened arrays

unit_box.log: ModelParameter logScale/expScale followed exactly; the SPE1 default point is approximately 0.5

value_semantics.matlab: setup/deck/state/model value assignments isolate candidate evaluations unless handle objects are explicitly involved
value_semantics.python: deep-copy or reconstruct mutable candidate inputs
value_semantics.required_invariant: evaluating candidate B after A equals evaluating B from a clean baseline
